faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Associate-I position at IIT Bhilai?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Research Associate-I position at IIT Bhilai is 31st August 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD in Physics, Materials Science, or Chemistry to be eligible for the Research Associate-I position. Experience in specific areas is preferred but not mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Research Associate-I position is 35 years. There are no specific minimum age requirements mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate-I role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of INR 58,000.00 per month for the Research Associate-I position at IIT Bhilai.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Research Associate-I position at IIT Bhilai?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email. You must send your completed application form along with your resume to the specified email addresses mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for the Research Associate-I recruitment at IIT Bhilai. Therefore, it is likely that no fee is required.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting candidates based on their applications. Shortlisted candidates will then be invited for an online or offline interview.

faq.answer: The provided data does not explicitly mention age relaxation for reserved categories. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for detailed information on age relaxation policies.

faq.answer: The Research Associate-I position at IIT Bhilai is a project-based role, indicating that the employment is tied to a specific research project.
